use std::collections::HashMap;
use gityas_domain::models::file::{ConflictChunk, GitYasConflict};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum DiffType {
    Equal,
    Delete,
    Insert,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct DiffOperation {
    op_type: DiffType,
    a_index: i32,
    b_index: i32,
    line: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct ChangeRegion {
    ancestor_start: usize,
    ancestor_end: usize,
    our_changes: Vec<String>,
    their_changes: Vec<String>,
    is_conflict: bool,
}

pub struct MergeAnalyzer<'a> {
    conflict_data: &'a mut GitYasConflict,
}

impl<'a> MergeAnalyzer<'a> {
    pub fn new(conflict_data: &'a mut GitYasConflict) -> Self {
        Self { conflict_data }
    }

    pub fn analyze_conflicts(&mut self) {
        let ancestor_lines: Vec<String> =
            self.conflict_data.ancestor.lines().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
        let our_lines: Vec<String> =
            self.conflict_data.ours.lines().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
        let their_lines: Vec<String> =
            self.conflict_data.theirs.lines().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();

        // Compute diffs from ancestor to ours and theirs
        let our_diff = self.compute_full_diff(&ancestor_lines, &our_lines);
        let their_diff = self.compute_full_diff(&ancestor_lines, &their_lines);

        // Find all change regions and classify them
        let regions = self.identify_change_regions(&our_diff, &their_diff);

        // Apply non-conflicting changes and collect conflicts
        let (merged_lines, conflicts) = self.apply_changes(ancestor_lines, regions, &our_diff, &their_diff);

        // Update the ancestor with merged result
        self.conflict_data.ancestor = merged_lines.join("\n");
        self.conflict_data.ours = our_lines.join("\n");
        self.conflict_data.theirs = their_lines.join("\n");
        self.conflict_data.chunks = conflicts;
    }

    fn identify_change_regions(
        &self,
        our_diff: &[DiffOperation],
        their_diff: &[DiffOperation]
    ) -> Vec<ChangeRegion> {
        let mut regions = Vec::new();

        // Group consecutive changes by ancestor line range
        let our_groups = self.group_changes_by_ancestor(our_diff);
        let their_groups = self.group_changes_by_ancestor(their_diff);

        // Merge overlapping or adjacent regions
        let all_ranges = self.merge_change_ranges(our_groups, their_groups);

        for (anc_start, anc_end) in all_ranges {
            let our_changes = self.extract_changes_for_range(our_diff, anc_start, anc_end);
            let their_changes = self.extract_changes_for_range(their_diff, anc_start, anc_end);

            // Determine if this is a conflict
            let is_conflict = !our_changes.is_empty() && !their_changes.is_empty() && our_changes != their_changes;

            regions.push(ChangeRegion {
                ancestor_start: anc_start,
                ancestor_end: anc_end,
                our_changes,
                their_changes,
                is_conflict,
            });
        }

        regions
    }

    fn group_changes_by_ancestor(&self, diff: &[DiffOperation]) -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
        let mut groups = Vec::new();
        let mut current_start: Option<usize> = None;
        let mut current_end: Option<usize> = None;

        for op in diff {
            if op.op_type == DiffType::Equal {
                continue;
            }

            let anc_line = op.a_index as usize;

            match current_start {
                None => {
                    current_start = Some(anc_line);
                    current_end = Some(anc_line);
                }
                Some(start) => {
                    if anc_line <= current_end.unwrap() + 1 {
                        current_end = Some(anc_line.max(current_end.unwrap()));
                    } else {
                        groups.push((start, current_end.unwrap()));
                        current_start = Some(anc_line);
                        current_end = Some(anc_line);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if let Some(start) = current_start {
            groups.push((start, current_end.unwrap()));
        }

        groups
    }

    fn merge_change_ranges(
        &self,
        our_groups: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
        their_groups: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
    ) -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
        let mut all_ranges = Vec::new();
        all_ranges.extend(our_groups);
        all_ranges.extend(their_groups);

        if all_ranges.is_empty() {
            return Vec::new();
        }

        all_ranges.sort_by_key(|r| r.0);

        let mut merged = Vec::new();
        let mut current = all_ranges[0];

        for range in all_ranges.iter().skip(1) {
            if range.0 <= current.1 + 1 {
                current.1 = current.1.max(range.1);
            } else {
                merged.push(current);
                current = *range;
            }
        }
        merged.push(current);

        merged
    }

    fn extract_changes_for_range(
        &self,
        diff: &[DiffOperation],
        anc_start: usize,
        anc_end: usize,
    ) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut result = Vec::new();

        for op in diff {
            let anc_line = op.a_index as usize;

            match op.op_type {
                DiffType::Insert => {
                    // Inserts reference the line before, so check if in range
                    if anc_line >= anc_start && anc_line <= anc_end {
                        result.push(op.line.clone());
                    }
                }
                DiffType::Delete => {
                    // Track deletions but don't add to result
                    continue;
                }
                DiffType::Equal => continue,
            }
        }

        result
    }

    fn calculate_line_range(
        &self,
        diff: &[DiffOperation],
        anc_start: usize,
        anc_end: usize,
    ) -> (usize, usize) {
        let mut result_lines = Vec::new();

        for op in diff {
            let anc_line = op.a_index as usize;

            // Only consider operations that affect our ancestor range
            if anc_line >= anc_start && anc_line <= anc_end {
                match op.op_type {
                    DiffType::Insert => {
                        // For inserts, b_index is 0-based array index, so +1 gives line number
                        result_lines.push((op.b_index + 1) as usize);
                    }
                    DiffType::Delete => {
                        // Deletions don't contribute lines to the result, skip
                    }
                    DiffType::Equal => {
                        // Equal lines are not changes, skip
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if result_lines.is_empty() {
            // Pure deletion case - find where the deletion would appear
            for op in diff {
                let anc_line = op.a_index as usize;
                if anc_line >= anc_start && anc_line <= anc_end && op.op_type == DiffType::Delete {
                    // The deletion happens at this position in the result
                    let pos = (op.b_index + 1) as usize;
                    return (pos, pos);
                }
            }
            return (1, 1);
        }

        let start = *result_lines.iter().min().unwrap();
        let end = *result_lines.iter().max().unwrap();
        (start, end)
    }

    fn apply_changes(
        &self,
        mut ancestor_lines: Vec<String>,
        regions: Vec<ChangeRegion>,
        our_diff: &[DiffOperation],
        their_diff: &[DiffOperation],
    ) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<ConflictChunk>) {
        let mut conflicts = Vec::new();
        let mut offset: i32 = 0;

        for region in regions {
            let adjusted_start = (region.ancestor_start as i32 + offset) as usize;
            let adjusted_end = (region.ancestor_end as i32 + offset) as usize;

            if region.is_conflict {
                // Calculate line ranges in ours and theirs
                let (our_start, our_end) = self.calculate_line_range(
                    our_diff,
                    region.ancestor_start,
                    region.ancestor_end,
                );
                let (their_start, their_end) = self.calculate_line_range(
                    their_diff,
                    region.ancestor_start,
                    region.ancestor_end,
                );

                // Create conflict chunk
                conflicts.push(ConflictChunk {
                    id: format!("chunk-{}", conflicts.len()),
                    start_line: region.ancestor_start + 1,
                    end_line: region.ancestor_end + 1,
                    our_start_line: our_start,
                    our_end_line: our_end,
                    their_start_line: their_start,
                    their_end_line: their_end
                });
            } else {
                // Auto-merge: apply the non-conflicting change
                let new_lines = if !region.our_changes.is_empty() {
                    &region.our_changes
                } else {
                    &region.their_changes
                };

                // Calculate how many lines to replace
                let old_len = (adjusted_end + 1).saturating_sub(adjusted_start);
                let new_len = new_lines.len();

                // Replace the range
                if adjusted_start < ancestor_lines.len() {
                    let end_idx = (adjusted_end + 1).min(ancestor_lines.len());
                    ancestor_lines.splice(adjusted_start..end_idx, new_lines.iter().cloned());
                    offset += new_len as i32 - old_len as i32;
                } else {
                    // Append at end
                    ancestor_lines.extend(new_lines.iter().cloned());
                    offset += new_len as i32;
                }
            }
        }

        (ancestor_lines, conflicts)
    }

    fn compute_full_diff(&self, a: &[String], b: &[String]) -> Vec<DiffOperation> {
        let trace = self.compute_myers_diff(a, b);
        self.trace_to_diff(&trace, a, b)
    }

    fn compute_myers_diff(&self, a: &[String], b: &[String]) -> Vec<HashMap<i32, i32>> {
        let n = a.len() as i32;
        let m = b.len() as i32;
        let max = n + m;
        let mut v = HashMap::new();
        let mut trace = Vec::new();

        v.insert(1, 0);

        for d in 0..=max {
            let mut new_v = v.clone();
            for k in (-d..=d).step_by(2) {
                let x = if k == -d || (k != d && v.get(&(k - 1)).unwrap_or(&0) < v.get(&(k + 1)).unwrap_or(&0)) {
                    *v.get(&(k + 1)).unwrap_or(&0)
                } else {
                    v.get(&(k - 1)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1
                };

                let mut y = x - k;
                let mut x_mut = x;

                while x_mut < n && y < m && a[x_mut as usize] == b[y as usize] {
                    x_mut += 1;
                    y += 1;
                }

                new_v.insert(k, x_mut);

                if x_mut >= n && y >= m {
                    trace.push(new_v);
                    return trace;
                }
            }

            trace.push(new_v.clone());
            v = new_v;
        }

        trace
    }

    fn trace_to_diff(&self, trace: &[HashMap<i32, i32>], a: &[String], b: &[String]) -> Vec<DiffOperation> {
        let mut x = a.len() as i32;
        let mut y = b.len() as i32;
        let mut diffs = Vec::new();

        for d in (0..trace.len()).rev() {
            let v = &trace[d];
            let k = x - y;

            let prev_k = if k == -(d as i32)
                || (k != d as i32 && v.get(&(k - 1)).unwrap_or(&0) < v.get(&(k + 1)).unwrap_or(&0))
            {
                k + 1
            } else {
                k - 1
            };

            let prev_x = *v.get(&prev_k).unwrap_or(&0);
            let prev_y = prev_x - prev_k;

            while x > prev_x && y > prev_y {
                diffs.push(DiffOperation {
                    op_type: DiffType::Equal,
                    a_index: x - 1,
                    b_index: y - 1,
                    line: a[(x - 1) as usize].clone(),
                });
                x -= 1;
                y -= 1;
            }

            if d > 0 {
                if x > prev_x {
                    diffs.push(DiffOperation {
                        op_type: DiffType::Delete,
                        a_index: x - 1,
                        b_index: y - 1,
                        line: a[(x - 1) as usize].clone(),
                    });
                    x -= 1;
                } else {
                    diffs.push(DiffOperation {
                        op_type: DiffType::Insert,
                        a_index: x - 1,
                        b_index: y - 1,
                        line: b[(y - 1) as usize].clone(),
                    });
                    y -= 1;
                }
            }
        }

        diffs.reverse();
        diffs
    }
}
